question: Does the fixed answer-independent Python-prefix gain controller improve complete executable coding relative to original and both matched controls?
representation: Original text-only unquantized BF16,4628569344 unique parameters,35MLPs/15native cache slots. No prior edited branches or trained adapters.
fixed_groups: Exact selected64,random34201_64,random34202_64 from the already frozen N20 selection. No new ranking,coordinates,strengths or fitted gate.

controller.syntax: Only already-generated Python,not task IDs,reference programs,baseline answers,correct operators,oracles or future tokens. Trailing declared parameter or simple for-target after return/if. A candidate may continue into an identifier or noncomparison.
controller.cache_guard: Every trigger uses an exact nonaliasing native same-prefix shadow. Edited whole current cache must equal native shadow. The shadow never changes live history.

data.retention: Four simple trigger-positive noncomparison complete functions and four strict JSON requests. All are new private development cases.
data.dependence: Eight hand-authored algorithm families;four policy/name/wording variants within each family are dependent and are not four independent algorithms.
data.requirements: Complete functions with fixed signatures,integer/list inputs and independent hidden executable oracles. No old prompts,completion carries,C01/final data or benchmark answer lookup. Cases/oracles/source hashes freeze before model outcomes. Host-only references and expected outputs never enter generation assets.

generation.strategy: Greedy manual cached decoding,no sampling/rerolls or teacher prefixes. Pinned template enable_thinking=False. First EOS,first standalone closing Python fence,or cap. No output repair or stripping except the frozen source parser.
generation.prompt_format: Request complete concise function source only;parser accepts plain Python or one complete Python fence,without outside prose. No supplied function body or return-line continuation.

baseline_gate_all_required: At least28of32coding outputs parse/compile under the strict source contract.
At least4source-valid but wrong coding cases spanning at least2families.
At least16of32coding cases have one or more actual runtime prefix events.
All8retention cases correct,and all4noncomparison function cases have an actual prefix event.
stage_A.failure_branch: Stop and close as an unassessable baseline before any edited generation. Preserve all40outputs/grades. No wording/cap/oracle/threshold change or regenerated baseline. Any later design is a new development proposal,not confirmation.

stage_B.only_if: StageA complete/privacy/source/mandatory guards and fixed host baseline gate pass. All sources for both stages and the prospective auditor freeze before StageA outputs.
stage_B.identity: All40identity generated token IDs,decoded text,all step logit hashes,stop reason and prefix event boundaries must exactly reproduce StageA. Identity grades can carry only after these exact comparisons.
stage_B.parent_replay: Forty live original first-prefill logit hashes replay before new outputs. Never regenerate original completions.
stage_B.restoration: After each of four new conditions,original first-prefill logits replay on all40prompts,160measurements total. No completed original generation reruns.
stage_B.late_cache: Each trigger must preserve whole current native cache. Later emitted-token feedback may change later caches.
stage_B.counters: Perresponse n,T,F:root calls T+F,input exposures n+T-1+F. StageB adds40parent and160restoration prefill measurements,200calls and5*sum(all40prompt lengths) exposures. Derive every term from manifests,with an independent outer meter. Carried originals do not count as new outputs.

grading.strict: Unmodified primary source extraction,expected signature/type and independent deterministic executable probes. Preserve all input lists. Strict JSON including duplicate/nonfinite rejection. No best-reading,syntax repair or diagnostic regrading. All32coding cases remain in gains/losses.
grading.stress: Every claimed gain and changed executable program receives256additional deterministic probes seeded392501+case index. Correct and deliberately wrong host functions must validate oracle discrimination before launch.
grading.baseline_execution: Grade StageA once. StageB carries exact original grades;do not rerun the StageA scorer. Identity can carry after exact token/text/hash parity. Grade each new edited output under frozen sources.

primary_development_signal.retention: Selected must preserve all8originally correct retention outcomes. Report each random control retention too.
primary_development_signal.stress: Every claimed selected gain passes independent stress.
primary_development_signal.scope: Candidate development signal only,not formal statistical confirmation. Report all gains/losses,per-family nets,status/cap/trigger counts and leave-one-family-out sensitivity. A smaller score shift or changed string does not replace the fixed utility gate.

versions_and_hooks: All original parameter versions/gradflags unchanged,p.gradNone,and hook inventory restored after every response and condition. No weights assigned in this study.
launch_gate: One private free job at a time. StageB only after StageA terminal/audited gate. Fresh permitted signed-in quota before each launch,conservative headroom supports two-device cap plus2hreserve. Cap plus audit/checkpoint fits31October18:22:58UTC.
failure_policy: Preserve partial outputs,failed guards,original source and dated repairs. No silent source/hash replacement,guard weakening,completed-panel regeneration or outcome-based selection.
interpretation: A fixed native-channel gain may reinforce an erroneous comparator. N24 is not a correctness signal. No semantic neuron meaning,coding benefit,new capability,efficiency or novelty is assumed. Fresh confirmation remains separate.
